items.title: Five EU states plan first deportation center in Africa for 2027
items.description: Greece, Germany, Austria, Denmark and the Netherlands are moving forward with plans to establish deportation centers outside the EU. An African partner country has reportedly already been selected.

items.title: France's Macron, Spain's Sanchez welcome idea of UK rejoining EU after Burnham remarks
items.description: During a visit to Spain, France's Emmanuel Macron said it would be "good news" if the UK moves towards the EU, with Pedro Sanchez also embracing the idea. UK PM Andy Burnham has not ruled out rejoining the bloc.
